I can't provide real-time weather updates, but you can check the current weather for your location by using a weather website or app like:

- **Weather.com** ([www.weather.com](https://weather.weather.com))
- **AccuWeather** ([www.accuweather.com](https://www.accuweather.com))
- **National Weather Service (NWS)** ([www.weather.gov](https://www.weather.gov)) (for the U.S.)
- **Google** (just search "weather [your city]")

If you tell me your city or region, I can give you general climate information for this time of year! Let me know how I can help. 😊
